title: $MEAT Weekend Game Challenge 🥩🎮
description:
A little $MEAT gaming competition for the weekend 🥩🎮 Jump into the game, test your skills and compete for the top score. Let's see who can master the game and claim the bounty!

 Requirements

- Play the $MEAT game: https://meatjump.netlify.app

- Try to achieve the highest score possible.

- Submit a screenshot showing your score before the deadline.

 Proof

Submit a clear screenshot showing your in-game score. Make sure the score is visible so it can be verified before a winner is selected.

 Selecting a winner

The winner will be the participant with the highest verified score submitted before the deadline.

If multiple participants achieve the same highest score, the earliest valid submission wins.

 Deadline

Sunday, October 18, 2026, at 23:59 UTC.

Additional notes

- Only valid, verifiable submissions will count.

- Please play fairly and submit your own score.

- This is an open bounty, so anyone can contribute to the prize pool.

- The winner receives the bounty reward, subject to POIDH's applicable fees.
